versions.changelog:
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify APIDot GPT Image 2 API entry points and usage flows.
- Added a "Start on APIDot" section with direct links for onboarding from ClawHub.
- No longer ships skill-card.md; now only SKILL.md and non-executable notes remain.
- No changes to main guidance, workflows, or API field coverage.

- Added non-executable reference notes in references/api.md to support local review without scripts or automation.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify the presence of references/api.md and to remove outdated references to the deleted skill-card.md.
- Removed skill-card.md, as the documentation is now focused within SKILL.md and references/api.md.
- No changes to API logic, workflow, or security guidelines.

- Initial release of the documentation-only skill for APIDot GPT Image 2 API workflows.
- Provides guidance for text-to-image, image editing, image-to-image, reference image generation, async task handling, polling, and webhook setup.
- Contains security practices and integration rules for handling APIDot API keys and async job workflows.
- Offers model-specific routing advice and direct links to official APIDot docs, examples, and support.
- No scripts, APIs, or credentials are included—only documentation and best practices.
